name: testland/dotnet-unit-tests
description: Use for any question or task about .NET tests in C#, F# or VB.NET, including quick how-to questions and choosing between xUnit, NUnit and MSTest: Fact and Theory tables, fixtures and shared state between tests, parallel runs, mocking, async tests, output, and coverage with dotnet test. Has authoring conventions and anti-patterns for xUnit.net.
